notes.title: Patch 1.2 - Missions Bug Fixed
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Version 1.2 is live.

With this patch, we've fixed the cross-route problems with the missions. Hence, missions and faction assignments are now included in the build!


 Missions will be unlocked again even when you continue to play from an old save. A total of 19 missions have been added, plus the alchemy items required for them.
 General rebalancing in stats has been done, now that they are back. (So if you notice a difference in numbers in comparison to before, don't be surprised!)
 4 new achievements have been added for completing the missions.
 And other bug fixes.


The supporter mini-guide has been updated to match the current stats. The full in-depth guide will be released shortly.

As always, thank you for your support.

Cheers,
Nifty Visuals team

notes.title: Version 1.0 live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41316607/f82b9a2635a9d693d14b6240348e2878248d515e.jpg

Hello everyone! The first version of the full release is now up!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41316607/7c1779dcf9d4ebd7e0d6974417f2210e99cf1185.png

Additional Notes

 Currently, 5/6 missions for each character and all faction missions are disabled. This won't have much influence on the gameplay, since the story is designed to work without them. We are currently fixing some cross-route inconsistencies before re-enabling them.
 Similarly, Lucius's Divination is closed after Week 10 due to cross route references. We will open it again in the next patch!




Thank you all for your encouragements and support! We really appreciate you all and hope you will enjoy the first release!

Cheers,
Nifty Visuals team
